prompt: How many versions of the .NET platform have been released that have a support lifetime of more than 12 months?
answer:
**12 versions** of .NET/.NET Core have had support lifetimes longer than 12 months.

This includes every version listed from **.NET 1.0 through .NET 10**, except **.NET Core 3.0**, which was supported for only about five months. The count excludes .NET 11 release candidates and .NET Framework versions.
